channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ação por vídeo de IA de Bolsonaro criminaliza o apoio político, diz Flávio ao TSE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged the TSE to dismiss an urgent injunction against an AI-generated video simulating a speech by Jair Bolsonaro at the PL convention, claiming the action by the Brazil of Hope Federation criminalizes political support. The video, produced using AI, sparked controversy for potentially violating electoral rules on deepfakes.

item.title: PF cancela depoimento de Flávio por calúnia contra Lula
item.description: The Federal Police canceled the scheduled testimony of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, PL’s pre-candidate for Presidency, set for Tuesday (July 28, 2026), regarding an inquiry into alleged slander against President Lula for a post comparing him to Nicolás Maduro. Bolsonaro’s defense argues the January 2026 post did not constitute a crime, as it expressed political opinion and repeated U.S. judicial accusations against Maduro, without attributing concrete false facts to Lula.

item.title: Após troca de ofensas do governo com Milei, embaixador brasileiro na Argentina não tem data para voltar ao país vizinho
item.description: Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, remains in Brasília after being summoned for consultations, with no set date to return to Buenos Aires. The decision depends on the Itamaraty's assessment of the 'evolution of the situation' in bilateral relations, particularly following Argentine President Javier Milei's insults against Lula and Alexandre de Moraes. Meanwhile, the embassy is being led by a chargé d'affaires, reflecting Brazil's diplomatic displeasure.

item.title: A reação de juízes e advogados ao ataque de Milei a Moraes
item.description: Brazilian judges and lawyers defended Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes after Argentine President Javier Milei called him 'bald trash' at the PL convention in São Paulo, labeling the remark an institutional attack on the Judiciary. The associations stressed that legitimate criticism of judicial decisions must be made through legal channels, not personal insults, and emphasized the importance of respecting judicial independence in international relations. The STF shared the statements on its official website.

item.title: IA de Bolsonaro e Milei: Flávio pode ter candidatura cassada, diz jurista
item.description: The use of an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro and the participation of Argentine President Javier Milei at the PL convention could constitute electoral abuse of power, according to jurist Márlon Reis, who warns that Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 candidacy may be annulled. The analysis highlights risks from illegal AI use and improper foreign influence in the campaign.

item.title: PL já trabalha com desistência de Cleitinho e pode apoiar Marcelo Aro (PP) ao governo de Minas
item.description: The PL is considering supporting Marcelo Aro (PP) for governor of Minas Gerais after Cleitinho (Republicanos) withdrew his candidacy due to mourning his brother's death. Aro, a former Bolsonaro tourism minister and Zema government secretary, is seen as a more competitive running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro in the state, with potential backing from 11 parties and 60% of radio and TV airtime.

item.title: Mais de 30 deputados argentinos repudiam Milei por ataques a Lula
item.description: Over 30 Argentine deputies signed a document condemning President Javier Milei's attacks on Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, calling the statements 'extremely grave' and warning of damage to bilateral relations and international law. The rebuke followed Milei's appearance at a São Paulo event supporting Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, where he used insults like 'thief', 'convict', and 'bald trash' to describe Brazilian officials.

item.title: Por escrito, Flávio diz à PF que texto sobre Lula foi mal interpretado
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro submitted a written statement to the Federal Police claiming that his January 3 post on X did not constitute the crime of slander against President Lula, arguing the text was misinterpreted: the reference to a possible Lula delation was a generic future prediction, not a false factual accusation, while the list of crimes referred solely to Nicolás Maduro. Lawyers assert there is no criminal intent, concrete offense, or objective elements of the crime of slander under Penal Code Article 138, and request the case be archived due to lack of just cause, alleging political motivation by third parties.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro apresenta esclarecimentos por escrito em inquérito e nega calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro chose not to testify before the Federal Police in the investigation into alleged slander against President Lula and submitted written clarifications to the Supreme Federal Court. His defense argues that the social media post linking Lula to a potential plea bargain by Nicolás Maduro was taken out of context and does not constitute a crime, as mentioning someone in a cooperation agreement does not imply criminal accusation. The inquiry, under Justice Alexandre de Moraes, is examining whether there was an offense against Lula's honor.

item.title: Na campanha do PL o candidato é o de menos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign strategists unveiled two ideas for the PL convention, neither featuring the candidate as a central figure. Both sparked controversy without clarifying the presidential aspirant's policy proposals.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro presta depoimento por escrito e diz que não caluniou Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) submitted a written deposition to the Federal Police, stating that his post about Lula and Nicolás Maduro did not constitute the crime of defamation. He is a pre-candidate for president in 2026 and denies any wrongdoing.

item.title: Aneel abre consulta pública sobre 1º leilão de baterias do Brasil
item.description: Aneel has opened a public consultation for Brazil’s first battery storage auction, scheduled for December 2026, featuring unprecedented rules such as requiring new equipment, banning cross-consortia, and increasing transparency. The auction will consist of two simultaneous tenders: one with a minimum national content requirement and another without. The main point of contention remains who will bear the costs, as a 2025 law stated the expenses would be divided only between...

item.title: Aliados defendem que Flávio faça novo gesto a Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro are urging him to make a new gesture toward Michelle Bolsonaro by attending the PL's Distrito Federal convention, where she will be confirmed as the party's Senate candidate. To avoid the appearance of a forced move, they believe he should meet with her in the coming days. The goal is to smooth their relationship ahead of the event.

item.title: A curiosa justificativa de Flávio para escapar de processo por calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) failed to appear for a Federal Police deposition regarding alleged slander against President Lula, opting instead to submit written explanations. His defense claims that stating Lula 'will be denounced' by Nicolás Maduro does not constitute criminal imputation, as it merely refers to being mentioned in a collaborator’s testimony, and that the second sentence of the post does not refer to Lula. The PF concluded the senator attempted to link Lula to crimes including drug and arms trafficking, money laundering, and support for terrorists, but the PGR supported holding the deposition prior to any potential indictment.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz à PF por escrito que não ofendeu Lula, e depoimento é cancelado
item.description: The Federal Police canceled the written testimony of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, scheduled for Tuesday (28), in an investigation into alleged slander against President Lula. Bolsonaro had agreed to respond in writing, stating he did not offend the president. The cancellation occurs amid an inquiry into statements made by the senator deemed offensive to the head of state.

item.title: Em depoimento por escrito, Flávio Bolsonaro nega calúnia contra Lula envolvendo Maduro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied in a written deposition having committed slander against President Lula for social media posts claiming Lula would be betrayed by Nicolás Maduro. The posts were made in January, when the then-Venezuelan president was captured by U.S. military forces. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Crivella e Benedita lideram disputa pelo Senado no RJ, diz pesquisa
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll, released on July 28, 2026, shows federal deputies Marcelo Crivella (Republicans) and Benedita da Silva (PT) leading the race for Rio de Janeiro’s two Senate seats, with Crivella at 17%-19% and Benedita at 14%-15% across two tested scenarios, within the 2-point margin of error. The survey interviewed 2,000 people aged 16+ from July 23–27, 2026, with a 95% confidence level and is registered with the TSE under code RJ-03487/2026.

item.title: Flávio apresenta defesa por escrito em investigação da PF sobre calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) submitted a written defense to the Federal Police in an inquiry investigating him for alleged slander against President Lula, claiming his post about Lula being 'delated' and accusations against Nicolás Maduro was a future prediction and repetition of formal U.S. charges, not an attribution of false facts. His lawyers request the case be archived, arguing there is no slander under STF and STJ standards, and that the statement falls within protected political speech.

item.title: Campanha de Lula se anima com ‘palanque internacional’ de Flávio
item.description: Lula’s campaign views Flávio Bolsonaro’s alignment with foreign leaders, such as Javier Milei, as a political misstep that could alienate moderate voters and boost the president’s polling advantage. While energizing Bolsonaro’s base, this approach is seen as damaging to efforts to attract undecided voters, key to winning in 2026. PL allies are increasingly concerned about Flávio’s moderation image amid misinformation about electronic voting and the Milei-backed convention.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula monta palanque sobre ruínas da OMC
item.description: The Lula government formally requested consultations with the United States at the WTO regarding two tariff measures adopted under Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act of 1974, which imposed additional tariffs on Brazilian goods. The move aims to challenge what Brazil views as unfair and unilateral trade practices by the U.S., amid a weakening of the multilateral trading system.

item.title: Exportações brasileiras para Argentina caíram 18% nos últimos 12 meses; veja os números da balança comercial
item.description: Brazilian exports to Argentina fell 18.1% over the past 12 months, driven by declines in vehicle and auto parts sales, reducing Argentina's share of Brazil's exports from 5.6% to 3.7%. While Argentine imports rose 3.8% in June, the trade imbalance unfolds amid rising diplomatic tensions between Lula and Milei, who exchange public criticism. The automotive sector remains central to bilateral trade flows in both directions.

item.title: PF cancela depoimento de Flávio Bolsonaro após defesa apresentar esclarecimentos em investigação por suposta calúnia contra Lula
item.description: The Federal Police canceled the scheduled testimony of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after his defense submitted written clarifications in an investigation into alleged slander against President Lula. The defense argues that the social media post linking Lula to crimes and Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro did not constitute a crime and requests that the written explanations replace the oral testimony. The inquiry was authorized by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes following a favorable opinion from the Attorney General’s Office (PGR).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro envia esclarecimentos por escrito à PF em inquérito sobre calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) submitted written clarification to the Federal Police regarding the investigation into alleged slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da slandpages seven pages defense, he states that he did not offend Lula and that the crimes attributed in his post refer to Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Brasil não define prazo para retorno de embaixador após críticas de Milei
item.description: The Brazilian government has not set a timeline for the return of Ambassador Julio Bitelli to Buenos Aires after recalling him to Brasília for consultations following Argentine President Javier Milei's insults toward Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes at the PL convention. Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira met with Bitelli and summoned Argentina’s ambassador to Brazil to formally protest, while Lula dismissed the remarks with a sarcastic 'Who is this guy?'.

item.title: Suplentes, senados estaduais e mandato vitalício: Veja cinco curiosidades sobre o Senado
item.description: Two-thirds of the Brazilian Senate will be renewed in the 2026 elections, making the race strategically important across the political spectrum. Each senator has two alternates, crucial for substitutions during the eight-year term — the longest of any elected office in the country. Historical rules such as state senates and the allowance for multiple candidacies in different regions have been abolished over time.

item.title: Paes lidera disputa ao governo do Rio de Janeiro, diz pesquisa
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) leads the race for governor of Rio de Janeiro according to a Real Time Big Data poll, with 37% of voting intentions in the first round. He would defeat both Douglas Ruas (PL) and Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) in a runoff, per the survey registered with the TSE under code RJ-03487/2026.

item.title: Flávio diz ao TSE que ação do PT contra vídeo criminaliza apoio político
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign tells the TSE that the action by the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PC do B and PV) seeks to criminalize political support from former President Jair Bolsonaro to his son, arguing that labeling 'political capital transfer' as an electoral irregularity is inappropriate. The defense claims the AI-generated video is not a deep fake because it disclosed its artificial nature, and urges the TSE to deny the urgent relief request and keep the video online pending judgment.

item.title: PT e aliados pedem que PGE apure participação de Milei em ato do PL
item.description: The Brazil of Hope federation (PT, PV and PCdoB) filed a notice of fact with the Electoral General Prosecutor’s Office requesting an investigation into the participation of Argentine President Javier Milei at the PL’s national convention, which formalized Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. The parties seek clarification on whether public Argentine or Brazilian resources were used, if there was institutional coordination between foreign authorities and the party, and whether the visit was financed with public funds to boost an electoral act, stressing that the request does not presuppose electoral wrongdoing but aims to clarify the legal nature and funding sources of the visit.

item.title: Big techs vão analisar denúncias de desinformação nas eleições encaminhadas pelo TSE
item.description: Major digital platforms, including Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Telegram, and TikTok, signed memoranda with the TSE to analyze disinformation reports in the 2026 elections using the Electoral Disinformation Alert System (Siade), except X, which opted for a direct email channel. LinkedIn committed to immediately removing malicious content, while Meta will provide access to WhatsApp’s API for direct voter communication. The agreements, signed on July 16 and disclosed on July 27, aim to strengthen digital governance without replacing the Electoral Judiciary’s role.

item.title: Gasto público em ano eleitoral: lições da PEC Kamikaze
item.description: The article examines public spending in election years, focusing on the 'PEC Kamikaze' (Constitutional Amendment 123/2022) as an attempt to circumvent the Election Law's ban (Article 73, §10 of Law 9.504/97) on distributing social benefits during election years. Despite being a constitutional amendment, the STF ruled it constituted 'abusive constitutionalism' and violated electoral principles of anteriority and isonomia, rendering it inapplicable. The ruling serves as a warning to the Executive Branch in 2026, emphasizing that even constitutional amendments cannot override core electoral rules essential to democracy.

item.title: Parceria entre Fundação Cacique Cobra Coral e Argentina remonta à Guerra das Malvinas
item.description: The Cacique Cobra Coral Foundation suspended its 'climate assistance' activities in Argentina after President Javier Milei called Brazilian President Lula a 'prisoner', 'thief', and 'socialist trash', and attacked Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The foundation demanded a formal apology from the Argentine government before resuming operations, stating the decision ends a cooperation dating back to the Falklands War and Raúl Alfonsín's administration. Milei also said he plans to visit jailed former President Jair Bolsonaro and accused the Lula government of supporting Argentina's opposition in the last election.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio tem maior rejeição entre mulheres em cenário com Lula
item.description: The July 2026 Datafolha poll shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leading voting intention among women, with 50% versus 40% for Flávio Bolsonaro in a simulated second-round scenario. Flávio has the highest rejection rate among women (50%) and overall (48%), though he has narrowed the gap with Lula since June. His pre-campaign is attempting to reverse this deficit through initiatives like the 'Brasil por Elas' plan, targeting women, and the potential selection of a female running mate.

item.title: Como funciona a Fundação Cacique Cobra Coral, que suspendeu atuação na Argentina
item.description: The Cacique Cobra Coral Foundation, a spiritual organization founded in the 1980s, suspended its 'climate assistance' to Argentina following critical remarks by President Javier Milei against Lula and Alexandre de Moraes. The foundation claims to influence weather through spiritual practices, though no scientific evidence supports its efficacy.

item.title: Entenda a "ajuda climática" dada pela Cacique Cobra Coral à Argentina
item.description: The Cacique Cobra Coral Foundation announced the end of its 'climate aid' to Argentina following remarks by Argentine President Javier Milei during his visit to Brazil, where he attended the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. Milei called Lula a 'prisoner' and Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash', which the foundation interpreted as a political attack on Brazil. The FCCC claims its climate interventions, based on spiritual and mediumistic techniques, have been provided since the Falklands War in 1982.

item.title: Paradoxo mineiro desafia Lula e Flávio
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll in Minas Gerais reveals a paradoxical scenario: the most competitive candidate for state government hesitates to move forward, while others, including the incumbent governor, are ignored by voters despite their candidacies.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: O novo pepino de Flávio Bolsonaro no TSE
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discussed the new challenge facing Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign at the TSE: an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro that may constitute an electoral violation. The program also covered party conventions and featured an interview with the party president. The controversy centers on the potential breach of electoral laws through the use of deepfakes in the campaign.

item.title: Saiba em quais Estados Lula e Flávio lideram nas pesquisas
item.description: Lula leads in 12 states with 67.13 million voters (42.29% of the electorate), while Flávio Bolsonaro leads in 7 states with 29.42 million (18.53%). Ronaldo Caiado leads only in Goiás (3.2%). The analysis shows that in 10 states, a first-round victory is possible, and the key difference lies in the electoral weight of the states each candidate leads. Data comes from Poder360, excluding Alagoas and Roraima due to lack of TSE-registered surveys.

item.title: Nova pesquisa testa disputa entre Tarcísio e Haddad em São Paulo
item.description: The Vox Brasil Institute conducted a new survey between July 29 and 31, interviewing 1,480 voters with a 2.55 percentage point margin of error at 95% confidence, to map the 2026 race for São Paulo governor and Senate. The poll will simulate a direct runoff between Fernando Haddad and Tarcísio de Freitas for governor, while also measuring rejection of six candidates and Senate voting intentions for ten names. It will assess approval of Tarcísio’s government, potential vote shifts, and the influence of televised debates on voter decisions.

item.title: Brasil promulga acordo de livre comércio entre Mercosul e Cingapura
item.description: President Lula promulgated the Free Trade Agreement between Mercosul and Singapore, establishing zero tariffs for Brazilian exports to the Asian country. The agreement, signed in 2023 and ratified in 2026, enters into force on August 1, 2026, marking the first such treaty between the South American bloc and a Southeast Asian nation. In 2025, trade between Brazil and Singapore reached US$10.7 billion, with a Brazilian surplus of US$4.1 billion.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Lula estreita laços com a China em meio a contexto eleitoral e crises com Argentina e EUA
item.description: Lula strengthens ties with China amid diplomatic tensions with Argentina and the U.S., which are seen as attempts at electoral interference. The call with Xi Jinping focused on strategic cooperation in AI, satellites, critical minerals, fertilizers, and a potential Mercosul agreement, as a counter to U.S. pressure.

item.title: Fundação Cacique Cobra Coral suspende cooperação com a Argentina: ‘Está por sua conta e risco’
item.description: The Cacique Cobra Coral Foundation, an esoteric institution claiming to control rainfall through rituals, announced the suspension of its climate cooperation with Argentina in response to offensive remarks by Argentine President Javier Milei against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The foundation stated that, without a formal apology, Argentina will be 'on its own risk' amid the onset of the El Niño phenomenon. It recalled having participated in a 'mystical operation' in Argentina in 1989 during a severe energy crisis.

item.title: Prefeito de Maceió aciona TSE para anular sua destituição do comando do Podemos em Alagoas
item.description: Maceió Mayor Rodrigo Cunha has appealed to the TSE to annul the decision by national Podemos president Renata Abreu that removed the Alagoas party directory, which he has led since June 2023. The legal action seeks to reverse the measure that stripped him of his state-level party leadership.

item.title: Deputado argentino apresenta projeto para repudiar ataques de Milei a Lula: 'Nos envergonham'
item.description: Argentine deputy Jorge Taiana introduced a resolution in Congress condemning President Javier Milei's remarks calling Lula a 'convict' and attacking Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes during Milei's visit to Brazil to support Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. Backed by at least 30 deputies, the proposal labels Milei's statements as slanderous, a violation of international law, and a serious detriment to Argentina-Brazil diplomatic relations.

item.title: Ataque de Milei a Moraes gera ‘extrema preocupação’, diz presidente da Ajufe
item.description: The president of Ajufe, Ana Lya Ferraz da Gama, expressed 'extreme concern' over Argentine President Javier Milei's insults toward Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes during Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign launch. She stressed that judicial decisions must be based on technical criteria, not external pressure, and that the attack targeted judicial independence. The Brazilian government summoned ambassadors to address the diplomatic crisis, which also stemmed from Milei calling Lula a 'prisoner'.

item.title: Governador de Minas descarta que ex-secretário de Zema rompa aliança para dar palanque a Flávio: ‘Palavra não faz curva’
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) ruled out that former Civil House Secretary Marcelo Aro (PP) would break their alliance with him and ex-governor Romeu Zema (Novo) to support Flávio Bolsonaro or run for governor with PL and Republicanos, stating his 'word does not bend'. He confirmed Aro remains his Senate candidate. The Genial/Quaest poll shows Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) leading with 35%, but Republicanos allies believe he will withdraw and back Aro, while the PL reassesses its plan to field a competitive candidate.

item.title: Ataque tardio de Caiado a Flávio corre o risco de não surtir efeito
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado launched his União Brasil candidacy with a delayed attack on Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him a 'Kinder Egg' and warning that backing the Bolsonaro heir would hand the PT the opponent Lula desires. However, the move came too late and faces internal party fractures, while Romeu Zema of Novo avoided direct confrontation with Flávio and remains stuck at around 3%, confirming the inability of the alternative right to break the Lula-PL polarization.

item.title: Lula empata com Flávio e Zema em cenários de 2º turno em MG
item.description: Lula is technically tied with Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema in second-round scenarios in Minas Gerais, according to a Genial/Quaest poll from July 2026. Against Zema, Lula has 37% to 39%; against Flávio, 38% to 35%, both within the 3-point margin of error. The survey interviewed 1,482 voters between July 22–26, 2026, is registered with the TSE, and cost R$ 233,840.06.

item.title: Raquel Lyra supera João Campos no 2º turno, aponta Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll released on April 28 shows that Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) leads João Campos (PSB) in the 2026 Pernambuco gubernatorial runoff with 45% voting intention, compared to Campos’ 39%, despite his endorsement by President Lula (PT). The survey indicates a reversal from the previous April poll, where Campos had been ahead, signaling Lyra’s growing momentum ahead of the campaign.

item.title: Cleitinho lidera cenários de 1º e 2º turnos em MG, diz Quaest
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicans) leads all first and second round scenarios for the Minas Gerais governorship according to a Genial/Quaest poll, with voting intentions between 34% and 35%. When he is excluded, incumbent governor Mateus Simões (PSD) technically ties with former Belo Horizonte mayors Patrus Ananias (PT) and Alexandre Kalil (PDT). The survey also showed high spontaneous undecidedness (88%) and measured rejection, government approval, and is registered with the TSE.

item.title: Presidente do DC diz que aprova eventual chapa de Zema com Joaquim Barbosa
item.description: The president of the Christian Democracy Party (DC), João Caldas, stated that he approves the possibility of Romeu Zema, governor of Minas Gerais from the Novo party, choosing former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa as his running mate in the 2026 presidential election. The comment was made in an interview released on July 28, 2026, indicating DC's support for a potential presidential ticket led by Zema and Barbosa.
